name: @lucyn/browser
description: JS client for the LucyN browser engine — a scraping-first, Chromium-powered headless browser driven over JSON stdio

scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('nothing-browser: the LucyN engine binary is not bundled with this package. Download it from https://github.com/LucyNBrowserEngine/LucyNEngine/releases and point LUCYN_BIN at it, e.g. export LUCYN_BIN=/path/to/lucyn')"
